# AAUH Mave-Tarmkirurgisk Afdeling

AAUH Mave-Tarmkirurgisk Afdeling (the Gastrointestinal Surgery Department at Aarhus University Hospital) is a surgical unit in Denmark that treats patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and related conditions. The department's performance is tracked through national quality indicators maintained by DANIBD, a Danish IBD registry. According to 2024 data, the department has a re-operation rate of 16 percent for surgical procedures—a metric that measures the proportion of patients requiring a second operation within 30 days of their initial surgery [^src1]. This rate exceeds the national development target of 8 percent, indicating an area where the department's surgical quality outcomes diverge from the benchmark standard [^src1].

The re-operation indicator is one of two major quality measures assessed in the DANIBD annual report. The other tracks the use of biological monitoring in IBD care, specifically the measurement of fecal calprotectin as part of treatment follow-up [^src1]. By publishing both indicators at the department level, DANIBD enables identification of units with particularly strong or weak performance, supporting quality improvement efforts across Danish IBD treatment centers.
